identity.title: Production VPS Hosting Direction Lock
identity.objective: Record Karl's final production-hosting decision as planning truth only: AlphaVPS, Sofia, Bulgaria, initial tier C8G (4 vCPU / 8 GB ECC RAM / 75 GB NVMe RAID-10), Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / x86-64, ONE_CONSOLIDATED_POLYMARKET_VPS with no default research/live split, telemetry-gated upgrades C8G -> C12G -> C16G/P-series -> larger, the production migration point after a real strategy-specific WP172 EXECUTABLE_EDGE_PASS and before the first serious production-hosted WP173 paper runtime, and the future NOT AUTHORIZED S10-DEPLOY-01 Production VPS Runtime Baseline package; supersede the WP61 cheap-VPS-later shorthand and the open VPS/cloud choice; reconcile PR #206 / S10-QUAL-DATA-03 as merged truth with the zero-network prepare as next runtime action and DATA-03 not moved to the VPS. Docs/tests only; no provisioning, purchase, deployment, credential, scheduler, paper, live or capital authority. Side14 drafted the package as size M; the repo spec guard caps M at 10 changed files, so the exact 13-path scope is classified L without any scope change.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-DEPLOY-PLAN-01. The hosting-direction contract, status fragment and package artifacts disappear and the ADR, charter, roadmap, status, repo-truth and deferred-log planning statements return to the prior wording. No source, runtime, data, host, credential, order or capital state exists to roll back.
